info.title: Kahuna.Benchmark
info.description: kahuna-bench sends sustained load to a Kahuna cluster and reports latency percentiles and throughput

options.name: --connection-source
options.description:
Required. Comma-separated cluster
endpoints, e.g.
https://h1:8082,https://h2:8084

options.name: --workload
options.description:
(Default: mixed) set | get | mixed |
delete | set-many | delete-many | txn |
bank | lock | sequence | script

options.name: --duration
options.description:
(Default: 30) Measurement window in
seconds (excludes warmup)

options.name: --warmup
options.description:
(Default: 5) Warmup seconds before
measurement; samples discarded

options.name: --concurrency
options.description:
(Default: 64) Number of concurrent
in-flight workers (closed-loop degree of
parallelism)

options.name: --rate
options.description:
(Default: 0) Target aggregate req/sec (0
= unbounded closed-loop; >0 = open-loop)

options.name: --key-space
options.description:
(Default: 10000) Number of distinct keys
cycled through (controls hit/contention
rate)

options.name: --key-prefix
options.description:
(Default: bench:) Prefix for generated
keys. End it with '/' (e.g. 'bench/') to
put every key in ONE hash key-space so a
set-many/delete-many batch lands on a
single partition (one ReplicateLogs);
the default 'bench:' spreads keys across
partitions.

options.name: --value-size
options.description:
(Default: 128) Value payload size in
bytes for write ops

options.name: --read-pct
options.description:
(Default: 50) For mixed: percentage of
reads (the rest are writes)

options.name: --batch-size
options.description:
(Default: 100) For set-many/delete-many:
number of keys mutated per batched
request

options.name: --keys-per-txn
options.description:
(Default: 4) For txn: number of keys
written per interactive transaction
before commit

options.name: --txn-locking
options.description:
(Default: pessimistic) For txn:
pessimistic | optimistic locking
strategy

options.name: --durability
options.description:
(Default: persistent) persistent |
ephemeral

options.name: --script
options.description:
Path to a .4gl transaction script used
by --workload script

options.name: --timeout
options.description:
(Default: 10) Per-request client timeout
in seconds

options.name: --format
options.description: (Default: console) console | json | csv

options.name: --output
options.description:
File path for json/csv output (defaults
to stdout)

options.name: --insecure
options.description:
(Default: false) Skip TLS validation for
self-signed dev/standalone certs

options.name: --grpc-channels
options.description:
(Default: 2) HTTP/2 connections the
client opens per endpoint. Each
connection is one serialized duplex
stream on both sides, so this is the
client-side parallelism knob

options.name: --batch-coalescing-threshold
options.description:
(Default: 10) Client batcher: batches at
or above this size skip the coalescing
delay (1 disables coalescing entirely)

options.name: --batch-coalescing-delay
options.description:
(Default: 2) Client batcher: max
milliseconds the dispatch loop sleeps
after a small batch to let more requests
accumulate (0 disables the delay)

options.name: --seed
options.description:
(Default: 0) RNG seed for reproducible
key/value selection (0 = time-based)

options.name: --routing
options.description:
(Default: auto) How the client picks a
node: auto | roundrobin | learned |
metadata. Auto learns when several
endpoints are configured and rotates
when only one is. Learned reuses the
destination a response reported for the
same resource; metadata also resolves
resources the client has not seen

options.name: --routing-endpoint-map
options.description:
Comma-separated advertised=dialled pairs
for a deployment where the address a
node advertises is not the one this
client dials, e.g.
https://172.30.0.2:8082=https://localhos
t:8082

options.name: --allow-unlisted-routing-endpoints
options.description:
(Default: false) Dial an endpoint a
response named even when it is neither
configured nor mapped. Off by default

options.name: --routing-counters
options.description:
(Default: false) Total the client's
routing counters and print them after
the run. Off by default: subscribing to
a meter makes every counter the client
publishes take a listener callback, and
only the routing modes publish any, so
leaving it on would tax one arm of an
A/B comparison and not the other

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.
